title: Authorities recover more animal remains in San Jose del Monte, Bulacan
summary: Authorities and an animal welfare group discovered nearly 30 sacks and plastic bags containing the remains of animals in three separate areas in Barangay Gaya-Gaya, San Jose del Monte City, Bulacan.
